hypothesis: Repair integration validation for bounded producers retaining XOR state while extracting an independent closed add reduction. Transactional optional recognition permits these generic sum/XOR AoS patterns to use early scalar fission; ordinary LV then selects the producer and consumer VFs independently. Preserve the integrated acyclic CFG, retained-state and final-export transformations and every inherited VPlan contract. This revision adds no semantic transformation, profitability model, vectorizability prerequisite, benchmark-specific code, source rewrite or math assumption.
semantics: Reduction recognition is a transactional optional result: a failed scalar candidate can remain in the producer but never changes ParticipationArm or ReductionInsts. Conditional candidates require exactly one nonidentity latch input, an add/fadd defined in that predecessor, an unconditional direct edge to the latch, identity header-PHI values on every bypass, and contribution dominance at the original terminal store point. Every header-PHI use is checked by operand number and incoming edge: only its own accumulator operand and identity bypass operands are allowed. Its update has only its own merge use. Before committing a candidate, every result use must be its own header backedge from the latch or the exact original latch edge of an Exit LCSSA PHI. Thus the first edge from any moved state cannot reach a retained recurrence, predicate, address, contribution or other reduction; no recursive dependence walk or PHI-order assumption is needed. Successful reductions still share one participation arm and are all conditional or all unconditional. Retained PHIs/starts/backedges, merges, arithmetic, flags and branches stay at their original sites and iteration order. Final producer exports retain d2 exact value/edge forwarding and dominance checks, including P=0 and a final inactive iteration. No last-participant substitute, speculative arithmetic, freeze or input reread is introduced. Acyclic branch-only CFG and finite/representable full-trip storage proofs, effect/call/load whitelist, strictfp/constrained-FP rejection, pointer-index ceilings, LCSSA and metadata contracts remain. The counter stores at old P and increments exactly once on the common terminal edge, retaining old P on every bypass; 0<=P<=N<=M bounds all stores and consumer reads. Ordered unconstrained FP clones original update operands/flags and executes exactly the original participating additions; P=0 returns the exact start without adding an identity. Explicit fission FP reordering is tested separately and adds no fast-math/errno assumptions. Chunk scheduling retains d2 canonical single-block, unconditional, zero-start/unit-step, equality-exit restrictions and now explicitly also excludes retained state. All compiler IR mutation still follows every rejection point. Executable verification requests actual original/transformed IR and independent C formulas for three new state/CFG/export interactions, eleven exact historical feedback/export fixtures whose whole-loop outcomes change, and the historical cross-reduction fixture, alongside every inherited matrix. Probes check N/P, all bypasses, vector/tail/empty/zero-entry/final-inactive paths before fixed-vscale host execution; uninstrumented original scalable output is separately RVV machine-verified. Revision t000049 changes no recognition, operand/edge closure or IR schedule. Default dispatch checks now bind the producer XOR and consumer add to their actual scratch values and observable results, account for every emitted loop, and check role metadata and original DILocation on each latch. Source-located selection certificates require exactly four original targets at dispatch.c:10/20/30/50:5 and independently read both stage VFs rather than applying VPlan forced widths to scalar stages. Exact original dispatch definitions are separately renamed/compiled as references. The C oracle computes wrapping uint32 sum and XOR independently, compares the original result/canaries to that formula and the transformed results to the original, including permitted aliased output. Probe counts use actual producer/consumer widths with no VPlan-tail instrumentation on early stages; per-configuration execution names/counters must match all generated early sum/XOR variants. The original VPlan stage and repeated-LV tail certificates remain unchanged and now run on an explicit isolated dispatch matrix under both policies. The ordered overlap and nested compact matrix remain. Serial/nested predicate select mutations remain; affine uses an applicable icmp eq-to-ne mutation and each must fail its intended export-control certificate after construction. New dispatch mutations check actual scratch, output, role, provenance and source-location obligations. The dispatch stage certificate accounts separately for any ordinary vector remainder emitted by follow-up hints, derives its width from its actual scratch access, and retains independent entry/lane counters alongside the four primary scalar/vector counters. Repeated-LV scalar VF-1 revisit remarks are permitted without overwriting the first observed primary stage width; all actual loops still require the original attached role and source location.
costs: No new scratch stream, retained-state array, mask array, runtime alias/SCEV/FP guard, input reread, duplicated producer operation or contribution recomputation is added. Full-trip entry allocations remain capped by the existing 65536-byte option and signed alloca pointer-index ceiling. New mixed interactions reserve [65 x i32], [65 x double], [65 x float]: 260+4 ABI padding+520+260=1044 bytes. Four reductions share three contributions. Logical stores are 16*P bytes and loads 16*P bytes (32*P total); P=0 has no scratch accesses despite full capacity reservation. 1043 rejects and 1044 admits, without compact/retained-state chunking. Seven distinct final producer values use seven scalar forwarding PHIs, including the final conditional state, with no scratch traffic. Historical retained-export cases reserve i32/double streams: 260+4+520=784 bytes; logical stores/loads are each 12*N for unconditional or 12*P for compact cases. Observed accumulators stay scalar and can supply a contribution to a moved independent accumulator without duplication. The dead cross-consumer uses one i32 stream with 260-byte full capacity. Enclosing inherited producers reuse their entry scratch per row. Chunk capacity, carried reductions, global input/local scratch indices, partial chunks and source/VF/traffic remarks remain as in d2; no state carry across chunks is implemented. Production analysis remains direct per-PHI incoming/use scans plus O(B+E) acyclic CFG and existing instruction/effect/export scans, SCEV bounds and dominance queries; one retained-state bit restricts chunking. No general SSA reconstruction, path enumeration, target cost model or new analysis framework is introduced. Validation adds small fixture-scoped retention/order/export certificates and independent formulas, reusing inherited typed compact-count, scalar/vector-result and export proofs. Physical stack layout/traffic, spills, RVV execution and speedup remain unmeasured. Revision t000049: early sum/XOR dispatch reserves one [65 x i32] stream (260 bytes), stores 4*N and loads 4*N logical bytes, with one scalar final XOR forwarding value. 259 bytes rejects retained-state chunking; 260 admits full-trip storage; the existing 519/520 tests retain ordered C=64/B=512 versus full C=65/B=520 behavior and oversized compact rejection. No input reread, producer duplication/recomputation or new runtime guard is added. The only compiler-code change emits the already computed source-located scratch traffic/reread/duplication fields for full-trip and compact schedules as well as chunks, without changing values or transformations. Validation adds fixture-bounded typed result-PHI checks, scratch/result/metadata/source certificates, independent wrapping C formulas and four scalar-stage probes using the inherited AoS counter interface. Default five-vscale matrix has 40 early sum/XOR configurations with 476 calls each (19040 planned comparisons); the explicit isolated VPlan dispatch adds another 19040 calls, preserving all old VPlan checks and ordinary-tail instrumentation. These are planned counts, not observed execution or performance. Ordinary vector remainders, if emitted by the unchanged follow-up hints, use the inherited extra entry/lane counter interface with actual scratch widths; no extra compiler scratch or reread is introduced.
